title: Galax-z v14
description: Galax-z v13 with SCREEN + the blue dial turning the OP-Z's parameter pages both ways.
notes: Hold SCREEN and turn the blue dial: the OP-Z's parameter pages, forwards and back. The page flashes on the dial LEDs when SCREEN is let go. SHIFT still goes forwards.
SCREEN + the green dial turns the Galax-z app's pages, as before: the OP-Z sends it as CC 105 on channel 16.

Everything of v13: GROOVE light green, the tumbler, EUCLID, the Quindar tones, older USB keyboards, pedal and wheel, presets that stay, the load meter, more live voices, A/B bars, boot animations, the debounce.
